# The Modern JavaScript Tutorial

> A comprehensive, free JavaScript tutorial covering fundamentals to advanced concepts including ES6 features, OOP, async programming, and DOM manipulation.

JavaScript.info is a widely-translated educational resource available in 12+ languages, serving as a complete learning path from beginner to advanced JavaScript development. The tutorial emphasizes practical, modern JavaScript practices with extensive coverage of language fundamentals, object-oriented programming, and contemporary features.

## Key Topics

- JavaScript fundamentals
- Object-Oriented Programming (OOP)
- ES6+ features
- Async programming
- Functions and closures
- Data structures (Map, Set, WeakMap, WeakSet)
- DOM and events
- Promise and async/await
- Error handling
- Code quality and strict mode
- Arrow functions
- JSON
- Symbol
- Data types
- Programming fundamentals

## Core Tutorial

- [The Modern JavaScript Tutorial](https://javascript.info): Main JavaScript tutorial covering fundamentals to advanced concepts
- [Tutorial Map](https://javascript.info/tutorial/map): Curriculum overview and learning path for JavaScript fundamentals
